text:
sam: quick heads-up — on-boarded ranklite-3b int4-fastquant into bench-suite. initial small holdout (5k) shows -2.8% NDCG@5 vs fp16. anyone seen this pattern?

li: is that across all cohorts or a slice? need breakdown (short vs long queries, dedupe behavior)

sam: main drops on short queries (<40 chars) and pools with many near-duplicate candidates. NDCG@1 down ~-4.7%, MRR -1.9%.

harper: duplicates amplify rounding noise. if two candidates were tied, tiny quant differences flip top1. did bench dedupe match prod?
sam: bench used light dedupe; prod uses fingerprint strong-dedupe. when I re-ran with strict dedupe the gap narrowed to -1.3%.

ops-bot: Note: bench job queued — eval/4101112223-baselines (tag=ranklite-3b, fpset=fp16)

li: also check preprocessing parity: bench was lowercasing for this dataset while prod keeps punctuation. short queries often rely on symbols.
sam: tokenizer versions match (tkn-v4) but lc-ing changes BPE for short tokens.

harper: calibration set matters: was PTQ calset generic? short queries/punctuation not well represented then. try domain calset (searchops) with per-channel scaling and a tiny post-rescale.
sam: calset was generic-10k. re-running with calset=searchops-2k + per-channel-scale + post-rescale=1.02. cmd:

bench-eval --model ranklite-3b --quant int4-fastquant --calset searchops-2k \
  --dataset bench-seedset-v1 --preproc prod-parity --dedupe strict \
  --quant-scale per-channel --post-rescale 1.02

ci-bot: CI: job 4101112223-2 finished — int4-fastquant + searchops calset: NDCG@5 = 0.278 (-0.6% vs fp16), MRR = 0.512 (-0.3%)

li: big improvement from calibration. still small residual gap. can you capture 10 failure examples so we can inspect token splits and candidate-text diffs?
harper: also add tests: no-kvcache and fixed-candidate-order to rule out nondet effects.
sam: queued no-kvcache + fixed-order job now. Short-term mitigation: route queries <20 tokens to int8. Long-term: add searchops calset to PTQ flow and extend bench holdout with strict-dedupe + short-query slice.

ops-bot: Reminder: open infra ticket for routing change.

li: can someone draft a short model-card blurb about int4 caveats (short-query sensitivity, dedupe parity, calibration recs)?
sam: on it — will paste blurb + 10 failure pairs once CI finishes. thanks!
